book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Mooa dyongona oetu, o'nosoo te manena te natzamawukwuna soomayuna, yise ewa tuka, Gi Namayuadu Tukaba tukakwu.
Mu Jew numu tutunehanedu ka Te Pabe'e watze batsakwu mee'e sokwama pana ka mu numu-ma suipunne.
Ka sumuoo Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu-matu, Judas mee naneadu soo suta'yoo ookow ma'emukwa.
Soo suta'yoo ka mu tutunehanedu-matoo ka Judas taya mu tuukwe tuunguna oosoo mu tzapoonnekukwu ka Te Pabe'e pukwi'yoona, o'no mu oo watze tzakadukwu.
Mu Jew numu tutunehanedu besa sokwamana, “Numme u tumanagakukwu,” mee'e ka Judas netamma.
Soo Judas, “Nu ka Te Pabe'e-matoo mu bikakwu, gi numu poonnena,” mee tusooyugwe.
Yaa tabenoo numme ka seepu tooa'a batsakwu, ka gi namayuadu tukaba noko ne ewa tuka-kwi manepetu.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka Peter noko John meeoo netamma, “Mu sakwa mooe memeakwatese ka te nanesootuhi yongo tukakwuna mabetsabega.”
Umu yise meeoo tubenga, “Hano'yoo yise numme tugoomahanegakwu?”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee mu nanekwegea, “Ka Jerusalem-wi mu pepetugase mu sumuoo nana bano'osa tu tsoabu-kooba tokwuhudu wegeakwu. Mu saa'a ookow nagekadooa. Ka nobe-kwi oo egeakase oo-nosoo saa'a tzoonooahoo kwatese
ka nana oo nobe-gakoo mee saa'a netamma, ‘Soo Te Pabe'e umu pumme nakatzimodu-no yaa u-baa'yoona nanesootuhi yongo tukakwu.’
Esoo nana nobe-ga'yoo yise mu tzapoonnekukwu ka pa'atu nobe-kwi'yoona ka tukapu mu yongo tukakwuna mu saadooa.”
Umu yise mooe memeow tu tukakwuna mahaneookwuse.
Ka tu yongose, soo Te Pabe'e ka umu nakatzimodu-no tukana
mee mu netamma, “Nu tubetse unu mu-no e nanesootuhi yongo tukakwuna petzape gisoo nabatzana.
Esoo te nanesootuhi yongo tukana ka numu-koobatu e nabatsakwuna oo wahadu ka seepu dooa nabatsa-kwa'ne. Yow nakwitu umu nanesootuhi tukakwuna e nabatsana-kobena.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka tseda gwuu'hoose atsa baa oekoo oo-koobatoo nanesootuhihoose umu pumme nakatzimodu mee netamma, “No'yoona sakwa mu ma-matu hebe.
Nu mu tuukwe'e nu ekow atsa baa ka yaa teepu-koobatu tubetse gi hebekwusoo, saa'a Te Naa ka te teepu mapudutupudoose o'no yise nu tubetse pudutupusoo hebekwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e ka tukaba gwuu'hoose ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhihoose oo tzabokase yise mee mu netamma, “Yoonnekoo soo e tookoo mu-koobatoo natzabokakwu eka tukaba-wa'ne. E soomayu saa'a ka a tukana.”
Ka mu tukamakwuse ooosoo ka tseda-witu yukwe soo Te Pabe'e meeoo unnena, “Nu sakwa mu-koobatoo nabatsa. Soo atsa baa e puupe-wa'ne'yoosoo.
Soo sumu'yoo numu ka umu nuka batsakwadu-tamme e tzamunahookwudu tamme-baa tuka.
Mooasoo soo Te Naa meeoo tunetamma, nu ooonnekoo nabatsakwu. Pana saa'a oosoo umu wohomu nu-matoo bikepu tuma'emukwana oo-matoosoo kodyukwu.”
Umu oo nakatzimodu yise mee nanatubenga, “Hanotugina tamme-matu yoo manekwu?”
Umu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu puusoo nanano nananepetukute. “Ka puusoo nana su'summe ka Te Pabe'e nakwasoo manepunnekwu,” mee'e nanatusooyugwena.

Soo Te Pabe'e ka mu nakana yise mee mu netamma, “Gi mu wakwawa'a numu-kooba katudu-kwa'ne, paba nasooyugwepana. Soo sumu'yoo mu-nagatu mooe natatsungadu sakwa mu tummatzi. Gi paba nananeyugwepana mu numu tummatzi, tooe nu mu Pabe'e pana nu ooosapa mu-kwitu poohigena. Mu sakwa e manena tuusoodyahana nu-kwa'nesoo. Soo sumu'yoo mu-nagatu mu mooe tatsungadu sakwa mu tummatzi. Mu ka numu tummatzidu gi heesoobedya. Pana nu mu Pabe'e, yise mu tummatza'e, mu sakwa nanatummatzi punno'o.
Mu nu-no tukakwu ka saa'a Te Naa-baa mu petukase. Mu yise nu-nosoo ka mu Jew numu nemadabuekwu mu ka ooosapa e naka'oedyukuna tooe mu numu nuka wohone sapa.
E besa pua'a Simon Peter, soo suta'yoo mu tapokakwu te manena gi petzabena.
Pana nu u nanesootuhikute u sakwa gi e naka'oedyukumakwupana. Ka u unnekwuna saa'a nemakodyuse u sakwa umu ta pupua'amu besa mu nanesootuhi meakwuna mu nemayugwekwu.”
Soo Simon Peter yise mee ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “Nu ooosapa u-no'yookwu tooe taka mu wutuma tooetoo taka mu goekwuse sapa.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka Simon Peter meeoo netamma, “Awamooasoo gisoo ka tsekuna kwu'a yaka, u saa'a pahe mu numu mee netammapunnedooa, ‘Nu maka Jesus gi sopedakwatoo.’ ”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka umu pumme nakatzimodu meeoo tubenga, “Nu ka o'nosoo ka besa e unnepu mu numu mu tuukwe tuunguna ka mu tayase tooe gi mu hee-gakoo sapa, gi tuwow mu mago'o-gana, gi tuwazoo kumma'akoosoo mu moko-ga'yoo sapa. Mu puu uga hemma tuuke haa'a?” Umu mee oo nanekwegea, “Numme u unne-kwa'nesoo gi hemma tuuke.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu netamma, “Ka yaa manakwana ka mease ka mu hemma mago'o noko hanega ka ooone-gana. Mu ka gi segesa-gana ka mu wegabedo tutsanabedu.
Soo nu-kwitu nanemamakwudu nabotugudu oo-toogoo manipetukwu. Mee oosoo na'unakwe, ‘Nu ka mu nanasuda tumatugudu-kwa'nesoo namatugukwu.’ ”
Umu oo nakatzimodu mee oo netamma, “Mooasoo numme waahoo segesa-ga'yoo.” “Gi nu mownnekoo segesa netamma,” mee'e soo Te Pabe'e mu netamma.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka umu pumme nakatzimodu-no ka nobe-kwi'yoona mea'ase ka po'woadu Olive mee naneadu-matoo petuga, oosoo ka uga ooosapa maneyina.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee mu netamma, “Mu sakwa nanesootuhi. O'no mu ka sutakoo mumme nemooaka mu gi oo-ma nakatzabedooa.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise gi haa'no umu kwinga'atoo mease meatzedose mee nanesootuha'e,
“E Naa, soo tubetse suda nuka tu yugwekwuna nu-tamme kemmana nu gi oo nasoomanekena. Ka ume nuka tunetammapu nu oo mayohokwu.”
O'no yise sumu'yoo soo Te Naa tummatziwabe soo toha kasa-ga'yoo oo-baa tabua petuse ka Te Pabe'e besakoosoo sootuhidooa.
Togesoo ka pumme tu yugwekwuna oo soonammetugupunne soo oo nanekoonana ka teepu-koobatoo puupe pasawedu-kwa'ne manewunu.
Soo Te Pabe'e ka nanesootuhimakwuse yotsese ka umu pumme nakatzimodu-baa petuhooga ka suda sokwamana mu utua'e mu mayu petuse,
mee mu netamma, “Mu sakwa gi utu'ipana. Yosuhoose nanesootuhigonno, o'no mu ka Sutakoo mumme nemooaga mu gi oo-ma nakatzabe-wa'ne'yoo.”
Ka Te Pabe'e togesoo yadooawunu soo nana Judas mee naneadu mu tukwutumadu-no ewow numu oo-baa moohe petu. Oosoo ka Te Pabe'e-baa petuse oo mitzadya'me. O'no umu oo sopedakwatoohoo.
Pana soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo o netamma, “Judas how u suda e matugukwuse sapa e mitzadya'me?”
Mu Te Pabe'e-no tunakatzimodu ka tukwutumadu poonnese meeoo ka Te Pabe'e tubenga, “Tamme haa'a umu-no nagoekwu?”
Sumu'yoo mu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu yise sumuoo mu Jew pabe'e tummatziwabe naka tseka'akwunihoo.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo oo netamma, “Mow sapa.” Ka meeoo oo netammase ka nana naka pukwikoo oo nakwuga'ahoo-kooba matuguse soo oo naka besa mani.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka mu Jew pabe'e tukwutumadu meeoo netamma, “Nu gi suda tumatugudu, gi naduyadu, gi tuduhadu tuwazoo. Gi sakwa mu koodoo'oo-ma e tumahepana, wobe-ma, tsegesa-ma tuwazoo.
Tooe mu ka e nanesootuhi nobe-kwikoo sapa gi nu-ma tzakadupu-ga'yoo. Muusoo too'e. Mooasoo soo tubope ebeoo nabotuku o'nosoo Te Naa tamme tuukwe-kwa'nesoo.
Mu tukwutumadu yise ka Te Pabe'e-ma tzakaduse oo bika ka mu Jew-numu tutunehanedu naa-matoo. Soo Peter kwinga'a mu-nakwi meadabe.
Ka mu numu yise ka tunehane nobe-kobenakoo pedahoose soo Peter yise ka mu numu-naga katu.
Sumu'yoo tseadumu yise ka Peter poonnese ka oo tsetsoogase yise meeoo unakwe, “Esoo nana ka Jesus-matu.”
Pana soo Peter yise meeoo unakwe, “Nu gi ma-notu.”
Ka mu numu togesoo aata'a, kumma'yoosoo numu ka Peter poonnese punno'o meeoosoo, “U punno'o umu-notu.” Pana soo Peter yise meeoo ka nana netamma, “Nu gi.”
Togesoo mu tuutooe kumma'yoosoo numu punno'o ka Peter meeoo netamma. “U tubetse yow ka Jesus nakatzimodu-matu. U Galilee-witu.”
Soo Peter meeoo mu netamma, “Nu gi mu numu nemooaga, nu gi umu-notu.” Togesoo ka Peter ookow nemayuyakwe soo tsekana kwu'a yagakooha.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka Peter poonnega'a. Soo Peter yise oo soomayuhoo ka Te Pabe'e pumme netammapu. “Gisoo ka tsekana yaka pahe tooe u gi e nanenama'yoodooa.”
Soo Peter pumme unnepu soomayuse yagakooha.
Mu tutukwutumadu ka Te Pabe'e nasootzamekuna oo pooe wutumase yise oo wupageta.
Yise meeoo oo tubenga, “U too'e no'okosoo gi hemma watzekudu, haga meno'o u wupageta?”
Mu ewa'yoo tutukwutumadu ha'yoo tooe oo netammana oo-ma'yoona naneko'e.
Ka tu tabuakese mu tutukwutumadu ka Te Pabe'e mu tunehanedu-koobenatoo hane petuga yise mu tutunehanedu meeoo oo tubenga.
“U haa'a yow soo nanetammadu Ne Pabe'e?” Soo Te Pabe'e mu nanekwegea, “Tooe mu mumme e tuukwe sapa gi mu e oedyuku-wa'ne'yoo.
Saa'a mu e poonnekwu Te Naa toogoopatu-kumaba e katu numme mu tunemadabuekukwu.”
Mu tutunehanedu yise meeoo oo tubenga, “U haa'a Te Naa Tooa?” Te Pabe'e yise meeoo, “Aha, nu yow soo Te Naa Tooa'a.”
“Oosoo ka meeoo naneyugwena puusoo gi toge-tamme kemmowgena,” mee mu tutunehanedu nana'unakwe.
